issue.title: Global Styles: Additional CSS may not display any error on failure to save
issue.author: sirreal

labels.name: [Type] Bug
labels.description: An existing feature does not function as intended

labels.name: Global Styles
labels.description: Anything related to the broader Global Styles efforts, including Styles Engine and theme.json

labels.name: [Feature] Site Editor
labels.description: Related to the overarching Site Editor (formerly "full site editing")

steps: Enter `/* </style> */` in the additional CSS input.
Open the network tab in the browser console to observe the failed save request.
Notice that no error message is displayed.
Notice that the browser responds with a 400, the content has not been saved.
reproduction.expected: Error messages should be displayed when save fails
reproduction.actual: No error message is displayed, save silently fails with HTTP 400
